basis: every contradicted cell of claim graph v1 (same corpus/entity/condition/reference frame; up and down asserted by disjoint paper sets). For each (up paper, down paper) pair the extractor-recorded comparator, population_age_group, study_type and era (pre-1997 / 1997-2016 / 2017+) are compared; a pair is MATCHED when every stated factor agrees, EXPLAINED when at least one stated factor differs, UNDETERMINED when a factor is unstated on one side and none differs. Papers asserting both directions are excluded from pairs.
caveats: factors are the extractor's fields and are themselves unaudited; the 25 human-read pairs (first_reads_v1) calibrate whether they are reliable enough for this typing
'genuine-disagreement candidate' means at least one matched pair exists, not that the cell is a true disagreement; comparator and population vocabularies are coarse (e.g. 'other patient group')
a matched pair can still differ in assay, tissue or outcome definition, which the row fields do not capture
